items.label: MA-AG civil: EthosEnergy Power Plant Services, LLC
items.detail: State consent judgment over employees' involvement in tampering with air pollution monitoring equipment at the Berkshire Power Plant in Agawam; date is the announcement date. Amount is a $1.1 million civil penalty plus a $200000 payment to fund electric vehicle charging stations; the plant owner and manager's criminal pleas and FERC payments are separate and not counted; the company does not admit the truth of the allegations.
